lines: TALENT: THE LINK — CLASSIFICATION: NONE. NO PRECEDENT ON RECORD.
log.title: Registry of Talents

skills.name: Patternwork
skills.note: Systems-thinking: seeing how a thing's parts drive it — plans, mechanisms, markets, people-in-groups.

skills.name: Even Keel
skills.note: Calm under load: pressure does not reach the hands or the voice.

skills.name: Appraisal
skills.note: Judging worth, quality, and provenance at a look.

titles.name: Talent: The Link
titles.note: Each woman I am fully intimate with becomes permanently linked to me; each of us chooses one attribute or skill of the other, gaining a permanent boost that grows as the other's linked attribute or skill grows.

inventory.name: A coin from the crossing
inventory.note: Warm, constantly. Unworn, uncirculated, a metal of no known kind. Declines appraisal.

inventory.name: Hearthholt's iron key-ring
inventory.note: An iron ring of five keys of five distinct ages, brass tag stamped HEARTHHOLT. Mapped: newest — the iron gate; second-newest — the great front door (ordinary lock; the house chose the magic that first night); middle — the walled garden's south door; FOURTH — the ivy-hidden green door in the garden's north wall, opening on the worn far-side path (its lock was never in the house); eldest (seamless, toolmark-less) — slides perfectly into the iron-banded cellar door and will not turn. Not jammed. Waiting. 'Not yet.'

affinities.name: Bond — Amy
affinities.note: Amy Laurens — PARTNER, CO-FOUNDER, tender of the web — tonight the hostess of the first dinner. Honored the greens ('cooked back to the giver with respect, or not at all'), claimed the cuttings ('in good ground by tomorrow's dark — you have my word as its steward'), and retired the wall: 'no more walls, Aelwyn. You come the front way from here on.' Set 'with us' down gently, unpressed — guest on no terms tonight; anything larger the evening decides in its own time. The toast: 'to the three of us at its table... may this be the first of a great many.' The keeper watches with new eyes, presuming nothing.

affinities.name: Bond — Aelwyn
affinities.note: Aelwyn — warden of the north fold, tonight the first guest in three generations, in the warm seat by the fire ('a gardener in from the cold gets the warm seat'). Took 'be at home here, with us' kindly and carefully — 'a roof asked to be home is a new one on me... the way you'd take any gift too large for the asking.' Asked to start again properly with Amy. Spent a held thing over the first of the meal: two nights ago she stood in the trees on last patrol and watched the dark house take light, window by window. 'I came down that path today thinking I'd find out what woke it. Instead I'm sitting at its table being told to be at home. It's been a strange two days. I find I don't mind them.'
